items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Louis Escobeda played trumpet and vibra harp.

ctx.x: I remember him mainly as a bass player. He's dead. He's been dead quite a long time. Oh yeah.

Louis Escobeda played trumpet and vibra harp. Ah. That was when the bandstand faced the front of Bourbon Street. You know what I'm saying? Faced Bourbon Street. We saw it completely renovated three times, enlarged on account of it. And eyeballs at that time started off at 65 cents. And many of the time I had a standing line outside waiting to get in to hear that jazz that we played because it was another renovation, you see? Jazz that almost became awake again, almost like a circle on a wheel, like a spoke on a…
You mean the people got interested in it?
